title: Angular momentum excludes a bounded central launch for 53 of 81 selected stars under axisymmetric motion
abstract: We test a central-launch explanation for known Gaia extreme radial velocities with published ground spectra. We select 81 confirmed stars with RUWE below 1.4 and parallax/error above 5. An exact polynomial bound covers continuous ranges of parallax, proper motion, ground velocity and Solar inputs. Under the stated idealized axisymmetric geometry, 53 stars cannot have left a region within 10 pc of the centre at speeds at most 2000 km/s. Five stars lack finite distance bounds and 23 finite intervals include zero. A wider combined error box retains 34 exclusions. This test needs no Galactic mass profile. It does not identify central ejecta, a new star, or an unbound orbit. Input boxes are sensitivity assumptions, not confidence regions. Binary motion, astrometric errors, force-axis changes and non-axisymmetric torques limit the interpretation. Code, exact inputs, hashes, tables, a figure and offline reproduction steps are included.

display.caption: Exact input-box bounds and launch exclusions for selected stars with published ground velocities. Static axisymmetric motion and the stated idealized Galactic frame are assumptions. Missing finite distance bounds add no exclusions.
